test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Popular cosmetics brands in India are __very expensive__.

options.text: take it with a pinch of salt
cost an arm and a leg

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom 'cost an arm and a leg' means something is very expensive.
 
• It is used to **emphasize the high cost of something.**
 
• Using** idioms can make sentences more expressive and engaging.**
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase 'are very expensive' can be effectively replaced by the idiom 'cost an arm and a leg'.

Hence, the correct idiom is : *Popular cosmetics brands in India **cost an arm and a leg**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Idioms are phrases or expressions that have a figurative meaning different from the literal meaning of the words.
 
• They are commonly used in everyday language to convey complex ideas in a simple way.
 
• Understanding and using idioms can enhance one's language skills and make communication more effective.
